routes.label: by appointment at an enrolment centre

note: The Cayman Islands Identification Card (My eID), under the Identification Register Act 2025 and the Cayman Islands Identification Card Regulations 2025, voluntary and rolled out in groups: Caymanians may apply from 23 January 2026, permanent residents and their dependents from 1 July 2026. The My eID site: available to all ages and free to Caymanians; one enrols by appointment, identity checked and photograph taken. The card shows its dates of issue and expiry, but its term and the time to issue aren't stated.

sources.said: In accordance with paragraph 3.(4) of the Identification Register Regulations, 2025 and paragraph 2.(4) of the Cayman Islands Identification Card Regulations, 2025, applications for issuance of the Cayman Islands Identification Card (eID) are being received and processed in accordance with this pol ... Applications received on or after 23 January 2026 for: Caymanians.

sources.title: Radio Cayman (Government of the Cayman Islands), My eID eligibility expanded (9 July 2026)
sources.said: with expanded eligibility now in effect from 1 July 2026. ... Applicants who meet the eligibility requirements may now book an appointment to enrol for their My eID card. During the enrolment process, applicants will have their identity verified, their photograph captured

sources.title: Cayman Islands Government, Department of eGovernment, My eID card features
sources.said: Front of the card displays your photo, full name, sex, nationality, date of birth, Cayman immigration status, unique ID code, dates of issue and expiry, and signature.
